title: MCH and Caishen: supply chain poisoning pushes iOS exploits

title: URGENT: iOS Exploits Are Being Actively Deployed via Poisoned JavaScript on BBC, Zoom, CNN and Other Major Websites
content: Research reveals that threat actors have compromised third-party JavaScript providers including Optimizely, Kissmetrics, StorifyMe, and Minute-ly to deliver iOS exploits through at least 21 major websites. The attack routes Mobile Safari users to Coruna and DarkSword exploit-kit infrastructure without any user interaction. Affected sites span multiple sectors including BBC, CNN, Fox News, Zoom,... title: US Logistics Cyber Threats: 3 Campaigns & Defense
content: Three distinct campaigns are actively targeting the US trucking and logistics sector through fraudulent business portals and malicious documents. HelloFriends uses fake FMCSA carrier verification portals to harvest credentials, SSNs, EINs, and fuel card information through phishing emails. title: agent-framework Compromised: Credential Stealer Targets Azure and CI Pipelines
content: On November 17, 2026, two malicious versions (1.26.1 and 1.26.2) of Microsoft's agent-framework Python package were published to PyPI for approximately 50 minutes before removal. The compromised packages deployed credential stealers through Python .pth files that executed automatically on interpreter startup.
